00.name: Narrator
00.text: As you get closer to the mountains of Penne you see a hooded figure standing on the trail in front of you.

02.name: Sweat
02.text: I suggest we remain cautious. Hooded figures blocking the road are normally a sign of danger.

03.name: Narrator
03.text: You continue to walk forwards until the hooded figure stands before you.

04.name: Sour
04.text: Move it buster, we're in a rush here.

06.name: Narrator
06.text: The figure in front of you throws off their clock.

07.name: Lord Burger
07.text: It is I. Lord Burger. Ruler of all patties and buns.

08.name: Sweat
08.text: Lord Burger the arch enemy of lord Pasta.

09.name: Lord Burger
09.text: Bahh. Don't even mention that impastar in the same sentence as me. Lord Pasta will rue the day he stole my secret patty recipe and opened a burger restaurant opposite mine.

10.name: Lord Burger
10.text: Now I'm here to steal his precious relic and leave a dark stain on his life forever, mwha hah hah hah ha. Now hand over the relic mortal.

11.name: Sour
11.text: Over their dead body. Don't worry lumberer we can take them.

12.name: Sweat
12.text: Not so fast. I have an idea. Lord Burger, everyone knows that your fond of games, so why not play one instead of fighting. If we win you let us pass and if you win, well we'll probably just fight you anyway.

13.name: Lord Burger
13.text: That has got to be the stupidest terms I've ever heard. Why would I agree to that.

14.name: Sweat
14.text: Sounds like someones a chicken. Bawk bawk.

15.name: Lord Burger
15.text: Fine we'll play a game. I get to ask any three questions, but you have to get all three right to pass.

18.name: Sweat
18.text: I'm negotiating so we don't have to fight.

19.name: Sour
19.text: Your negotiating skills are terrible. Lord Burger gets to ask us any question, any, we don't know what their going to ask us and if we get one wrong we just fight anyway. Lets skip the formalities and just go straight to kicking his buns.

20.name: Sweat
20.text: Are you serious? We still have a chance to get out of this without fighting. I say we take it no matter if the odds are against us.

21.name: Sour
21.text: We didn't fight the tree and the lumberer lost their axe. But this is lord Pastas archenemy and we have a chance to deal with them once and for all. Let's fight.

22.name: Sweat
22.text: We fought the tree and won but that doesn't meen we can win again. Let's take the safer option and try to beat the odds.

fight_1.name: Sweat
fight_1.text: Careful mortal. Lord Burger knows how to use magic, make sure you block againts it.

play_0.name: Lumberjack
play_0.text: Let's play your game. Ask your questions.

play_1.name: Lord Burger
play_1.text: So be it. First question what is my favourite colour?

play_2.name: Sour
play_2.text: What. How are we supposed to know that.

play_3.name: Lord Burger
play_3.text: You said I got to ask any question, so I say again what is my favourite colour?

play_5.name: Sweat
play_5.text: Ha ha. Two more to go.

play_6.name: Lord Burger
play_6.text: Don't get to cocky just yet. Next question.

play_7.name: Lord Burger
play_7.text: What is the name of the forest spirit guardian?

play_8.name: Lord Burger
play_8.text: How could you possibly know that?

play_9.name: Sour
play_9.text: Let's just say that the spirit guardian was all bark and no bite.

play_12.name: Lord Burger
play_12.text: What kind of seed can be found on most burger buns?

play_14.name: Sweat
play_14.text: Ha ha. We win, you lose. Time to let us pass.

play_15.name: Lord Burger
play_15.text: Fine but tell your lord that he hasn't seen the last of me. I will continue to smudge and splatter his name till the day I die.

play_16.name: Sour
play_16.text: Sure. Whatever. Just let us pass.

play_17.name: Narrator
play_17.text: Lord Burger steps aside and allows your group to pass.

wrong.name: Lord Burger
wrong.text: Incorrect. Now it's time to die.
